about: Sign in with Google from an app opened from the Home Screen icon: the first tap is the redirect (the path his iPhone takes, unchanged), the redirect's return is read at start-up, a return with no account or with an error is said on the sign-in line, and the next tap uses the pop-up; a Safari tab still calls the pop-up first and falls back to the redirect. Graded by gate 171 (TC-R236a..j) on a trial bundle with the four Firebase modules answered by recording stand-ins and the Home Screen display mode emulated (navigator.standalone and matchMedia display-mode), at 375x761 with his insets, 320x568 and an iPad-sized 820x1180, after a tap and a return. NOT COVERED: the real Google and Firebase round trip, Safari's storage partitioning, and what iPadOS does with a pop-up opened from a Home Screen app - no browser here is WebKit on an iPad; his check on his iPad from the Home Screen icon is what proves those.

breaks.name: redirect-return-swallowed
breaks.why: the start-up read of the redirect's result throws its outcome away again (getRedirectResult(auth).catch(function(){})), so a return with no account or with an error leaves the app exactly as it was - the reported defect

breaks.name: home-screen-always-redirects
breaks.why: an app opened from the Home Screen icon takes the redirect on every tap, so after a redirect that came back empty the next tap goes round the same redirect instead of the pop-up

breaks.name: app-never-hears-the-return
breaks.why: index.html reports the failed return but the app no longer listens (the CTCloud.onSignInIssue subscription is gone), so nothing is said on the sign-in line
